theorems.name: Submission.iwl_cr_ip_wt_product_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), (∀ A : Set (Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable m A → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ K) < ∞) → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))).restrict {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A} = Measure.map (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons p.1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ p.2))) ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A))) → ∀ M : Set (Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable m M → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M ∩ K) < ∞) → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))).restrict {y : Eucl (P + 1) | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ M ∧ EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1} = Measure.map (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons p.1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ p.2)))) (((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)).prod ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M))
